title: gradeLevel is hardcoded to '7' in AgentChatWindow
body: AgentChatWindow line 28: `const [gradeLevel] = useState<string>('7')`. The comment says 'should be fetched from user profile'. The gradeLevel should come from the authenticated user's profile, not be hardcoded.
rationale: Hardcoded gradeLevel means the learning agent always thinks the user is in grade 7, which could lead to inappropriate response complexity for actual grade levels.
